response.justification: Candidate lacks critical technical requirements for this role. While demonstrating strong software engineering practices and some leadership experience, he has only 6 months of C++ experience versus the 8-year minimum requirement—a hard requirement that is failed. His career has focused on web and application development rather than cloud infrastructure and compute platform engineering. His infrastructure experience is primarily in application-level microservices and DevOps tooling, not cloud compute platform architecture.
strengths: Strong software engineering fundamentals with extensive experience in TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring across multiple senior and staff-level roles
Full-stack versatility with ability to master diverse technology stacks and solve problems across domains
concerns: Critical gap: Only 6 months of C++ experience versus 8-year minimum requirement
Limited expertise in cloud platforms, compute technologies, and infrastructure engineering despite some DevOps tooling experience
Career trajectory in web/application development rather than cloud infrastructure or compute platform domains
